[[Elder Crocodile (Tarnished Coast)|Elder Crocodile]]s are hostile [[crocodile]]s that can be found near waterfalls.

==Locations==
*[[Tarnished Coast]]
**{{NPC location|Arbor Bay}} ([[hard mode]] only)
**{{NPC location|Verdant Cascades}}
{{ongoing drop research}}

==Notes==
*Unlike other [[charmable animal]]s, they [[drop]] both [[Currency|gold]] items as well as [[seasonal item]]s during [[special event]]s.

==Trivia==
*Prior to the [[Game updates/20090409|April 9, 2009 update]], this used to be a charmable animal, allowing players to quickly get a level 15 [[animal companion]].
